problem:
What is the value of $h(t)=[\begin{aligned}{3}^{t} \\ {t}^{2}-1 \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]$ at $t=0?$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $h(0)=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=0$ into our function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}h(0) & =[\begin{aligned}{3}^{0} \\ {0}^{2}-1 \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(0)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
